## Fatima's impressions

-   Puzzles were quite interesting
    -   a few with locks, so they can be a little boring
    -   a few needed cooperation, so they were fun
-   Some technical glitches at the very beginning of the game and some equipment was too silent during the game
-   Overall, the flow was straightforward and there was no time of staring at things in frustration
-   Some puzzles we got partially through good "guess" (even though we figured the proper way of solving it)
:::
